knownGeometryCaveats.caveat: Distance and endpoint validation must use the main route track, not a continuous join across all GPX points.
Current GPX tracks the eastern route choice after Vika; Stormon and Grillholmen are kept pending until branch handling is settled.
The only >500 m intra-segment step is a 514.7 m simplification near Marma.
The inter-segment gap from the main endpoint to the station spur is about 1296.6 m and should not be auto-connected.
